Confirm the selected layout, area and pool provision with SAMANA.

additionalDocuments.label: SAMANA Ocean Pearl 2 · original official brochure and home drawings

review.imagery: Twenty-one own-project renders cover the twin-block building, private/shared pools, play and fitness spaces, refreshments terrace, cinema, lobby, gym, treatment setting and home interiors. All 25 native resources and six primary gallery assets were visually reviewed against the complete brochure. Generic beach/family photographs, duplicate hidden white-background models and unpainted resources are excluded. The complete building-and-roads aerial supplies the listing and developer-hero card cover. Proposed waterfront settings remain unit-unspecific.
review.floorPlans: Four complete official home sheets show 1 BR + pool, 2 BR + pool, 3 BR without pool and 4 BR + pool. The 2 BR includes a maid room and the 4 BR includes a store. Five complete building sheets from Mitchell’s branded broker mirror cover the podium and exact floor groups through floor 6 across blocks A and B. Additional store/maid variants appear in the floorplate legends. Separate detailed drawings for every variant, numerical home areas and contractual numbered-unit matching are unavailable. Confirm the selected layout, area and pool provision with SAMANA. All four complete official sheets 32–35 and all five mirror floorplates 2–6 were visually reviewed. The 3 BR sheet explicitly shows no pool. The podium parking and two home footprints, both blocks’ unit numbers, exact grouped floors, north markers and category legends remain intact. No missing category drawing or numerical home area is invented.
review.location: Complete physical page 10 regional map and all eleven page 9 travel entries were visually reviewed. The primary agrees with the printed travel groups. The JBR estimate and ambiguous canal/metro/Heritage Village labels require independent current routing. No operational station claim is inferred from symbols. The project-name map query retains its primary HTML hash. Exact plot entrance coordinates remain unavailable.
review.provenance: Official primary HTML, original brochure, native render origins and Mitchell’s complete branded building-plan PDF have receipts and SHA256 checks. Broker hosting remains explicitly labeled. Complete source sheets, original PDFs and physical page links are preserved. Protected identity and completed text research remain intact.
review.cardSelection: 8 November 2026: the proposed complete building and roads from above (samana-ocean-pearl-2-aerial) now supplies the listing and developer-hero card cover, superseding the original cover selection. The complete-building aerial replaces the twin-block waterfront frontage repeated on Ocean Pearl; proposed waterfront settings remain unit-unspecific. Own source: https://www.samanadevelopers.com/storage/projects-files/2025/09/01/10/45/e654ce95f17a218653f26a0b299c7855.pdf#page=6. Only the card selection changes; original gallery assets, source attribution and image-scope qualifications remain unchanged.

unavailable: Drawing-specific numerical home areas, separate detailed drawings for every floorplate variant, contractual numbered-unit matching, exact visitor entrance coordinates, independently confirmed JBR routing and ambiguous destination identities, final unit views/finishes and dated construction photographs were not established.
